deterministic.description: Normalised OTM Black value b(x, s) on a 70x55 log grid incl. near-ATM-forward (|x| >= 1e-14), tiny total vol and deep tails; relative tolerance only, values below 1e-290 (float64 underflow region) must be <= 1e-280

deterministic.name: bsm_published_examples
deterministic.description: Textbook worked examples, compared at the printed rounding (half unit in last place)

tolerance.atol: half unit in the last printed decimal

deterministic.name: identities_bsm_analytic
deterministic.description: C - P = D(F - K); D max(F-K,0) <= C <= D F; D max(K-F,0) <= P <= D K (European, continuous carry)

deterministic.name: greeks_fd_sweep
deterministic.description: Analytic Greeks vs central finite differences of the price over a bump-size sweep; the best bump must agree (truncation vs rounding trade-off)

deterministic.name: implied_vol_round_trip
deterministic.description: Price the stress matrix with mpmath references, invert, compare volatility; cases whose time value is below the bound tolerance must return at_lower_bound

deterministic.name: implied_vol_failure_cases
deterministic.description: Adversarial quotes must yield the specific structured status

deterministic.name: crr_european_vs_bsm
deterministic.description: CRR European price vs closed-form BSM over the stress matrix at N and N+1 steps; bound k*S*sigma*sqrt(T)/N; invalid-probability setups must be rejected

deterministic.name: american_identities
deterministic.description: American >= European on the same tree; American call == European call when q = 0, r >= 0 and no dividends; American put >= intrinsic

deterministic.name: crr_vs_quantlib_fd
deterministic.description: CRR (4000 steps) vs QuantLib 1.43 FdBlackScholesVanillaEngine (American; escrowed cash dividends) and AnalyticDividendEuropeanEngine (European with cash dividends)
